name: Selective Trickplay Repository
description: Repository for Selective Trickplay Generator plugin

repositories.name: Selective Trickplay Generator
repositories.description: Generates trickplay only if any selected user has not watched the movie or episode, and trickplay does not already exist.
repositories.overview: Automatically generates trickplay (preview) thumbnails for movies and episodes that are unwatched by at least one selected user.
repositories.changelog: Initial release - Core functionality for selective trickplay generation, multi-user watch status checking, scheduled task with configurable users, comprehensive logging, and plugin configuration UI support.
